policy: A UI surface may be merged, replaced, or removed only after every preserved capability is exercised through its replacement. Add new release-critical interactions here with an outcome-level verifier.

preserves: responses and tool calls remain in one chronological surface
responses default expanded and work groups default collapsed while remaining independently foldable
live-to-complete transitions do not override the user's disclosure choices
group cancellation does not cancel sibling or parent work
external file drops reach the chat attachment path even when nested content consumes drag events
WebView2 file-item fallback remains available when the standard file list is empty
unreadable drops show a visible explanation instead of failing silently
selection and context-menu AI handoff remain usable
selected text can start a user-confirmed AI edit request
only the assistant turn bound to that request becomes the proposal
revision or content drift blocks automatic proposal application
chat sharing and legacy import remain separate document portability actions
one document surface retains rendered editing
the active document panel can detach into a shell window
release UI assets contain the user-visible entry points
